# Fresh Prints

> Fresh Prints is an emergency and same-day commercial printing company in San Diego, CA. It serves businesses only (B2B) and does not accept personal or consumer orders. Finished jobs are delivered directly to the client's business; there is no walk-in storefront.

- Website: https://realfreshprints.com (the business name is "Fresh Prints"; the domain is realfreshprints.com)
- Phone: (619) 500-1959
- Hours: Monday-Friday 8am-8pm, Saturday 8am-4pm
- Service area: San Diego County, including Kearny Mesa, Sorrento Valley, Mission Valley, Carmel Valley, Poway and Rancho Bernardo
- Turnaround: same-day, next-day and rush jobs; timing depends on job type, quantity and file readiness
- Accepted files: PDF, PNG or JPG, uploaded at https://realfreshprints.com/upload

## Products

- [Booklets](https://realfreshprints.com/booklets): rush booklet printing
- [Catalogs](https://realfreshprints.com/catalogs): emergency catalog printing
- [Flyers](https://realfreshprints.com/flyers): rush flyer printing
- [Labels](https://realfreshprints.com/labels): rush product and packaging label printing
- [Packaging](https://realfreshprints.com/packaging): emergency printed packaging
- [Packaging sleeves](https://realfreshprints.com/sleeves): rush packaging sleeve printing
- [Postcards](https://realfreshprints.com/postcards): emergency postcard printing
- [Kearny Mesa postcards](https://realfreshprints.com/kearny-postcards): same-day postcard printing in Kearny Mesa, up to 10,000 postcards
- [Stickers](https://realfreshprints.com/stickers): rush sticker printing
